name: Natsusaki Yomi
source: [spoiler]The real Yomi turned out to be sickly and doesn’t have much more to live. Miraculously she managed to last until a few years later where Yousuke had to move away to Tokyo, that’s when the real Yomi passed away.[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]The real Yomi turned out to be sickly and doesn’t have much more to live. Miraculously she managed to last until a few years later where Yousuke had to move away to Tokyo, that’s when the real Yomi passed away.[/spoiler]
